name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

jobName.description: The name of the created workflow

model.description: The current model. This model's source of truth will be retrained without any currently faulty sensors.

relation.description:
The relation between the model and the asset, if applicable. This is the relation to the asset for which it's
{@link Sensor} was faulty.

This process currently does not support multiple assets for a single model.

modelConfigRun.description:
The Model Config Run to associate with the retraining. This is used for training the job and eventually
providing the user notifications about this retraining.

See #createWorkflow

title:
See {@link FaultySensor} for details about the overall faulty sensor process.

Trains a new model without the faulty sensors, if necessary. This is a sub-process of the
{@link FaultySensor.Orchestrator.Spec.Process} process.

See #createWorkflow to understand how this retraining workflow executes.
name: FaultySensor.Orchestrator.Spec.Retrain
